alkyl-nitrites-and-inhalants.gaps: The cyanide first-aid use is on EUDA only (undated profile). FRANK says the substances were once used to treat angina and gives that as the origin of the name 'poppers', but its sentence reads 'Nitrates', so it was not used. ADF says alkyl nitrites widen blood vessels and relax muscles: left out to keep to four lines. Lists of household products named on the pages were kept to three words (glues, aerosols, gases).
